Specification, Proposer & Gate ('Three-Body' Metaphor) [M/S · unmetered]

Unmetered architecture essay using 'Three-Body' strictly as a software role metaphor (Specification, Proposer, Deterministic Gate) — invoking zero gravitational physics or lab hardware runs.

1/2 Why two-party prompt-to-commit drifts:
- Asking one stochastic model to interpret an underspecified prompt AND judge its own patch hides silent regressions
- Isolating an executable gate (typechecker, SAT/SMT, tests) turns generation into bounded trial-and-check [M/S]

2/2 Candid specification limits:
- A gate enforces only its written specification: proposers still overfit weak test suites (Qi et al. 2015; Wang et al. ICSE 2026)
- Writing strong specs carries upfront human authoring cost
- Strictly unmetered essay (N=0 runs, joules=null)
